text:
Emma (CS): Hey team — VeoHealth renewal stuck. Procurement says PO entity doesn't match contract and signer rotated. I sent the DocuSign envelope but it's on hold. Any quick path?
Lina (Sales): Thanks Emma. Customer uploaded a PO but signer is 'Mark Chan (Interim CFO)'. They didn't include delegation doc. PO number they sent: 789-VE-2026.
Mike (Legal): We need explicit delegation to accept an interim signer. Email OK if it clearly states delegation (signed scan preferred).
Jack (VeoHealth): cc @Olivia (Finance) — yes CFO changed last week, sorry for the churn. Uploading docs now.
Jack (VeoHealth): Uploaded: https://files.veohealth.example/po_scan.pdf
Olivia (Finance): I can reissue PO with correct billing entity/name. New PO will be in our format: `PO-2026-0417`. ETA by EOD.
Emma (CS): DocuSign envelope ID `0a1b2c3d` — it's sitting at 'pending signing' because invoice section doesn't match PO. We can't finalize without updated PO reference.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0a1b2c3d status changed to 'on_hold'.
Lina (Sales): If finance reissues, we can update envelope. @Mike can Legal confirm that an emailed delegation is sufficient for us to proceed?
Mike (Legal): Emailed delegation is acceptable if it's explicit. Template we can use: `I, [Original CFO], authorize [Interim CFO] to sign on my behalf for agreements related to Redwood Inference, dated [date].` Ask the customer to reply-all with that exact phrasing or a signed PDF.
Jack (VeoHealth): Sending delegation now (reply-all).
Jack (VeoHealth): "I, Priya Rao, authorize Mark Chan to sign on my behalf for Redwood Inference agreements dated 2026-03-20." Attached signed PDF.
Olivia (Finance): New PO attached. PO-2026-0417. Billing entity matches contract.
Emma (CS): Great — I'll update the envelope with new PO and recipient name, then resend. Please confirm the PO appears in the invoice field exactly as `PO-2026-0417`.
Lina (Sales): 👍 Once envelope completes, we should run the seat-trueup and finalize invoice.
Emma (CS): Updated and resent: https://docusign.example/envelope/0a1b2c3d?status=sent
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0a1b2c3d status changed to 'completed'.
Billing Bot: Invoice created referencing PO-2026-0417, charge date set to 2026-04-01.
Olivia (Finance): Will include PO reference on the invoice and send to accounts payable.
Emma (CS): Closing the loop — renewal was blocked ~48 hours by procurement/PO mismatch, now cleared. Noting risk: customer org changes may add 1–2 day delays in future. :white_check_mark:
Jack (VeoHealth): Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround, much appreciated!
Emma (CS): Marking renewal as 'completed' in CRM and moving to onboarding kickoff.
